standard.summary: 动态批量大小调整时每次增减的步长。默认 1。
standard.effect: 当 AutoController 判断需要调整 batch size 时，每次增减的数量。
standard.whenToUse: 开启动态 batch 调整策略时使用。默认 1 是最保守的步长。
standard.avoidWhen: 未启用动态 batch 调整时此参数无意义。

standard_en.summary: Step size for each dynamic batch-size adjustment. Default 1.
standard_en.effect: How much the batch size moves each time the AutoController decides an adjustment is needed.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the dynamic batch adjustment strategy is on. The default 1 is the most conservative step.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless while dynamic batch adjustment is off.

advanced.principle: 动态 batch 调整是实验性功能，根据梯度方差和内存状态自动调整每步的有效 batch size。
advanced.tradeoffs: batch size 变化会影响学习率有效性（通常 batch double → LR double），需要同步调整 LR 或使用自适应优化器。

advanced_en.principle: Dynamic batch adjustment is experimental: it automatically adjusts the effective per-step batch size based on gradient variance and memory state.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Batch-size changes affect learning-rate validity (usually batch double → LR double), so the LR must be adjusted in sync or an adaptive optimizer used.
